consequence.statement: The evidence only states that the flag was added: operators who do nothing see no change, and environments that do not pass --redis-compress are unaffected; the flag's default value and any effect when unset are not stated.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds the global command-line flag --redis-compress for setting Redis compression.
